user.title: Svensk hockey
user.description: Choose the league you want match calendars for.

teams.title: Teams in {league}
teams.description: Pick one or more teams to follow. Each team gets its own calendar with the full season. A calendar with every game in the league is created too, but is disabled by default.

abort.already_configured: This league is already set up. Add more teams from its options instead.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the league's schedule. Try again later.

init.title: Teams and match length
init.description: Change which teams you follow, and how long a match is assumed to last. The league-wide calendar with every game can be enabled from its entity settings.

data_description.game_duration: Used as the end time of each calendar entry. A hockey match normally takes about 150 minutes including intermissions.
data_description.live_interval: How often to re-read a game in progress. The league's own site uses 60 seconds.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the league's schedule. Try again later.

get_standings.name: League table
get_standings.description: Return the current table for a league. While games are being played the table counts them in unless live is turned off.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league to read the table for.

live.name: Live table
live.description: Count the games being played into the table. On by default whenever any are running; turn off for the published table.

get_game.name: Current or next game
get_game.description: Return a team's current or next game.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

team.name: Team
team.description: Team code or name, for example LIF or Leksands IF.

get_play_by_play.name: Live game
get_play_by_play.description: Return the live state and goals of a team's current game.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

team.name: Team
team.description: Team code or name, for example LIF or Leksands IF.

get_highlights.name: Highlights
get_highlights.description: Return highlight clips for a team, newest first.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

team.name: Team
team.description: Team code or name, for example LIF or Leksands IF.

get_results.name: Results
get_results.description: Return a team's played games, most recent first.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

team.name: Team
team.description: Team code or name, for example LIF or Leksands IF.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many games to return, newest first.

highlights.name: Highlights
highlights.description: Match each played game against the league's highlight clips.

get_recap.name: Get recap
get_recap.description: Return a summary of the team's most recent game: score, goals, shots and where it left them in the table.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

team.name: Team
team.description: Team code or name, for example LIF or Leksands IF.

game_id.name: Game
game_id.description: Which game to recap. Defaults to the most recent one played.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Return the league's remaining games, every team included.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many games to return. Defaults to 20.

team.name: Team
team.description: Limit to one team. Leave empty for the whole league.

before.name: Played games before
before.description: How many games already played to include before the next one. None by default.

highlights.name: Highlights
highlights.description: Match each played game against the league's highlight clips.

get_player.name: Get player
get_player.description: Return a player's statistics for the season so far.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

team.name: Team
team.description: Team code or name, for example LIF or Leksands IF.

player.name: Player
player.description: The player's name, with or without the shirt number.

get_roster.name: Get roster
get_roster.description: Return every player who has turned out for a team this season, with their statistics.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

team.name: Team
team.description: Team code or name, for example LIF or Leksands IF.

get_form_table.name: Get form table
get_form_table.description: Return the table over each club's last few games.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

last.name: Games
last.description: How many of each club's most recent games to count.

team.name: Team
team.description: Mark this club's row as your own.

get_live.name: Get live games
get_live.description: Return tonight's games with the score as it stands, read when asked for.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day to list. Left out, today with live scores; another day comes from the schedule.

get_statistics.name: Get statistics
get_statistics.description: Return the league's statistics for every skater, goalkeeper and club: points, shots, power play, face-offs, save percentage, attendance and more.

location.name: Games
location.description: Every game, or only home or away games.

last.name: Last games
last.description: Count only each one's most recent games. Hockeyallsvenskan only.

set_goal_reference.name: Set goal reference
set_goal_reference.description: Remember what was sent for a goal, such as a Telegram message id. The swedish_hockey_goal_updated event hands it back so the message can be edited.

config_entry_id.name: League
config_entry_id.description: Which league the team plays in.

team.name: Team
team.description: Team code or name, for example LIF or Leksands IF.

game_id.name: Game
game_id.description: The game_id from the swedish_hockey_goal event.

score.name: Score
score.description: The score the goal made, from the swedish_hockey_goal event.

reference.name: Reference
reference.description: What to hand back in swedish_hockey_goal_updated, for example a message id.
